text:
Crispy Cheesy Beef Pockets

Comment “Recipe” and I’ll send you the full recipe for free.

If you’re always looking for new dinner ideas, you’re in the right place. That’s why I share simple and affordable meals that help you eat better and spend less.

Follow me for more Weeknight Staples.

Ingredients

Beef Filling
• 1 lb ground beef
• 1 yellow onion, diced
• 4 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 tbsp chili powder
• 1 tbsp cumin
• 2 tsp garlic powder
• 2 tsp paprika
• 1 tsp onion powder
• 1 tsp oregano
• 1 tsp salt
• 1 tsp black pepper
• 2 tbsp tomato paste
• ½ cup beef broth
• ½ cup red bell pepper, diced
• ½ cup green bell pepper, diced
• ½ cup corn

Pockets
• Burrito-size flour tortillas
• Mozzarella cheese

Garlic Butter
• 3 tbsp butter, melted
• 2 cloves garlic, minced
• 1 tsp dried parsley
